Sermon Curator helps a pastor move from one message to a weekly formation experience, a sermon series, a 21-, 30- or 40-day journey, and ultimately a 12-month discipleship strategy shaped by the pastor's own theology, voice, sermon library and congregation.

Sermon to Strategy

Every result opens an ecosystem.

Single sermon → 7-day devotional → sermon series → small groups → families → 21/30/40-day journey → annual formation strategy.

This prototype uses a starter set. The repository already contains archive and catalog datasets that can seed the full index.

04 · Sunday to Saturday

Every sermon becomes a 7-day formation experience.

The message no longer ends Sunday. Curator automatically creates a daily devotional rhythm that can remain digital or become a printed 52-week devotional product.
